clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Branstock Khalder trains dwarven priests in the Holy Light and watches the trogg threat beyond the outpost.

At Anvilmar, Branstock Khalder guides aspiring priests through their first prayers and sacred runes. This easy-going dwarf is devoted to the Light, yet keeps watch on the growing trogg threat to the local mountaineers. When a novice has learned enough of the Light, Branstock sends them through Coldridge Pass to Kharanos for further guidance from his superior, Father Maxan Anvol.
